purpose: list entries for one canonical authorized directory with bounded pagination.

source.source_text: Purpose: list entries for one canonical authorized directory with bounded pagination. Input: path:string, cursor?:string, limit?:1..500, include_hidden?:boolean. Output: names/types/safe metadata and next cursor. Contract: L1 read_only; scope mac.files.read; target path; timeout 5000ms; cap 256KiB; network none; filesystem read_allowed_roots; deny secret content and filter protected entries; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 2 planned.
